task.title: Add CSV import button to Renzo contacts page
task.description:
ADD a CSV import feature to the existing Renzo contacts page. Surgical edits only:

1. Add a hidden file input and 'Import CSV' button to the contacts view toolbar (next to existing Add Contact button)

2. Add JS function parseCSV(text): splits by newline, detects headers (looks for name/company/email/phone case-insensitively), returns array of row objects

3. Add JS function showCSVPreview(rows, headers): shows a modal with first 5 rows and column mapping dropdowns

4. Add JS function confirmCSVImport(rows, mapping): creates contacts from rows, skips if name+company both empty, shows 'Imported X, skipped Y' toast

5. Add CSS for csv-preview-modal and csv-preview-table styles

Use FileReader API. No external libraries.
